about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P440e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport P440e uses the AJ300 — a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six petrol engine with plug-in hybrid electric assistance. Fitted to the current-generation L461 from 2022 onward, the AJ300 combines a conventional petrol engine with an electric motor integrated into the gearbox, delivering a balance of performance and efficiency unique to the P440e badge. The PHEV system adds complexity beyond a standard petrol engine — we confirm your exact engine and hybrid specification by registration before any work begins, so you're quoted on the correct setup from the start.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300 engines for every Range Rover Sport P440e on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P440e ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The L461-generation P440e uses the AJ300 PHEV powertrain — a specific configuration combining the 3.0-litre Ingenium petrol engine with an integrated electric motor and battery system. Unlike the non-hybrid P400 or the V8-powered P530/P635, the P440e's hybrid system affects how the engine is serviced, which components are checked, and what's replaced during a rebuild. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ300) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
